title: A 2007 Home Video Sold for $760,999 and Left YouTube

scenes.text: It was uploaded to YouTube back in 2007.
More than 880 million people watched it.
In May 2021, it sold as an NFT in an online auction.
Then it was taken off YouTube.
The buyer got no copyright, and copies are still online. $760,999 for a video you can find for free.

description:
A 2007 home video sold for $760,999 as an NFT in May 2021, then came off YouTube.
It had passed 880 million views, but the buyer did not get the copyright and copies remain online.
Would you pay that much for a viral video?
first_comment: What is the most viral video you remember?
